description: Set the timeline's length and frame rate. Absolute values, omitted field unchanged. Shortening the duration below an existing keyframe does not delete it, but playback stops before reaching it — read the keyframe times back with studio_timeline_get_state before shrinking. The frame rate only governs the next_frame and previous_frame steps of studio_timeline_playback; it is not a render setting. Requires the Timeline plugin.

duration.description: timeline length in seconds (Timeline's own default is 10)

frame_rate.description: frames per second used when stepping (Timeline's own default is 60)

output.description: same shape as studio_timeline_get_state, interpolables listed without their keyframes
